Combination Sum I (LC39) — unlimited reuse
blocks.py:
def comb(i, rem, c, cur, out):
    if rem == 0: out.append(cur[:]); return
    for j in range(i, len(c)):
        if c[j] > rem: break
        cur.append(c[j])
        comb(j, rem - c[j], c, cur, out)   # SAME j: reuse allowed
        cur.pop()
